notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
description:
Cast Plague of Vermin by paying {6}{B} and choosing to pay any amount of life, creating that many 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a Rat.
When the Rat dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 2 as able.
